standard_prerequisites.use: Pro-etale sites, weakly contractible affine schemes, derivedI-completion, constructible complexes with finiteTor amplitude, lifting idempotents and finite projective modules. The local complete-zero and complete-limit support is retained.

core_obligations: Split themodI locally constant cohomology on a finite disjoint open cover and lift the resulting idempotents to finite projective completed-coefficient modules.
Build the bounded complex by induction onTor amplitude, using derived completeness to eliminate the residual quotient and keep all lifts compatible.

proof_roadmap.step: Split themodI locally constant cohomology on a finite disjoint open cover and lift the resulting idempotents to finite projective completed-coefficient modules.

difficulty_reason: The task constructs an actual finite projective completed-coefficient complex, not only its cohomology sheaves. The idempotent lifting and amplitude induction under derived completeness are concrete H2 obligations.
